---
title: "FAPROTADX2 DB conversion to FAPROTAX1"
author: "Lars Schreiber"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Rationale
With the update of FAPROTAX v1 to v2 the ability to add custom functions to the database was lost. So in order to leverage the more comprehensive v2 database and the better mapper script, we will try to get our custom functions as good as possible into the v2 db.

```{r loading necessary libraries}
library("tidyr")
library("readr")
library("stringr")
library("igraph")
library("dplyr")
```

``` {r read data and convert format}
# Read v2 database
faprotax2_db <- read_tsv(file = "FAPROTAX2_db/FAPROTAX2-db_main.tsv.gz")

# Read custom functions and v1 data
fpt_custom <- file("FAPROTAX1/FAPROTAX.txt", open = "r")

recognized_guild <- NA_character_

fpt_guild_to_taxa <- data.frame(guild = character(),
                                taxon = character(),
                                source = character())


# Loop line by line
while (TRUE) {
  # Read exactly 1 line at a time
  line <- readLines(fpt_custom, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  
  # Check if we have hit the End of File (EOF)
  if (length(line) == 0) {
    break
  }
  
  if(str_detect(string = line, pattern = fixed("# -")) & is.na(recognized_guild)){
    message("Detected block delimiter, but block is not defined. Please review FAPROTAX1 reference file.")
  }
  
  # Check if we hit a comment line
  if (str_detect(line, pattern = "^#")) {
    next
  }
  
  ## Check if we are in empty lines between guild blocks, if yes reset the guild id to NA
  if (str_trim(line) == "") {
    recognized_guild <- NA_character_
    next
  }
  
  ## Check if we previously recongized a guild if not then we are at a guild right now!!!
  if(is.na(recognized_guild)){
    recognized_guild <- str_split_i(string = line, pattern = fixed("elements:"), i = 1)
    #message("Recognized guild: ",recognized_guild)
    next
  }

  # Extract taxon assignments
  ## Check if guild has been recognized previously
  if(!is.na(recognized_guild)){
    ## Read taxon information under this guild
    current_taxon <- str_split_i(string = line, pattern = fixed("#"), i = 1)
    current_taxon <- gsub("\\s", "", current_taxon)
    
    current_source <- str_split_i(string = line, pattern = fixed("#"), i = 2)

    ### Add taxon to final mapping df
    fpt_guild_to_taxa <- rbind.data.frame(fpt_guild_to_taxa,
                                          data.frame(guild = recognized_guild,
                                                     taxon = current_taxon,
                                                     source = current_source))
    next
  }
}
close(fpt_custom)

# Create a db2 style taxon name to see how many species are already contained in the v2 db
fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2 <- str_replace_all(string = fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon,
                                              pattern = fixed("*"),
                                              replacement = fixed("_"))

fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2 <- str_replace(string = fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2,
                                          pattern = "_$",
                                          replacement = "")

fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2 <- str_replace(string = fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2,
                                          pattern = "^_",
                                          replacement = "")

#fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2[!(fpt_guild_to_taxa$taxon_v2 %in% faprotax2_db$species)]


# Turn v2 database into v1 style df
db_v2_df <- data.frame(guild = character(),
                       taxon = character(),
                       source = character())

all_funcs <- colnames(faprotax2_db)[colnames(faprotax2_db) |> 
                                      str_detect(pattern = fixed(".value"))] |> 
  str_replace_all(pattern = fixed(".value"), replacement = "")

for (func in seq_along(all_funcs)){
  #func = 1
  function_column <- paste0(all_funcs[func], ".value")
  reference_column <- paste0(all_funcs[func], ".source")
  
  # Subset and filter the dataframe accordingly
  faprotax2_db_sub <- faprotax2_db[,c("species", function_column, reference_column)]
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub[faprotax2_db_sub[[function_column]] == "P",]
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[!is.na(faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[function_column]]),]
  
  # Remove all entries without a reference
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[!is.na(faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[reference_column]]),]
  
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- unique(faprotax2_db_sub_filt)
  
  # Replace all internal underscores with * in species names
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species <- str_replace_all(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species, pattern = fixed("_"), replacement = fixed("*"))
  # Add terminal *
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species <- paste0(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species,"*")
  
  # Sort by species name
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[order(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species),]
  
  
  current_func <- all_funcs[func]
  
  # Loop through the species for putting them into a data frame
  for (species in seq_along(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species)){
    #species = 1
    # Pad species name with the right number of tabs
    current_species <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species[species]
    current_ref <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[reference_column]][species]
    # Convert reference to plain ASCII
    current_ref <- iconv(current_ref,
                         from = "",
                         to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT",
                         sub = "")
    # Add to growing df
    db_v2_df <- rbind.data.frame(db_v2_df,
                                 data.frame(guild = current_func,
                                            taxon = current_species,
                                            source = current_ref))
  }
}

# How do the guilds match up???
fpt_guild_to_taxa$guild <- gsub("\\s", "", fpt_guild_to_taxa$guild)
unique(fpt_guild_to_taxa$guild[!(fpt_guild_to_taxa$guild %in% db_v2_df$guild)])

# Remove the functions not being a custom function and being unique to the v1 database
#undesired_funcs <- c("chloroplasts","nonphotosynthetic_cyanobacteria","photosynthetic_cyanobacteria")
#fpt_guild_to_taxa <- fpt_guild_to_taxa[!(fpt_guild_to_taxa$guild %in% undesired_funcs),]

# Merge both databases
## Add initial * to taxon names in v2 db
db_v2_df$taxon <- paste0("*",db_v2_df$taxon)
colnames(db_v2_df)
colnames(fpt_guild_to_taxa)

merged_db <- rbind.data.frame(db_v2_df[,c("taxon","guild","source")],
                              fpt_guild_to_taxa[,c("taxon","guild","source")])
## Uniquify database
merged_db$criterium <- paste0(merged_db$taxon, "_", merged_db$guild)
merged_db <- merged_db[!(duplicated(merged_db$criterium)),]

## The order of the guilds has to be so that sub-categories (i.e. nested categories) are defined before their parent/umbrella 
## category. So we will have to find a guild order that works.

### Create a df that contains all nested categories
guild_order_df <- merged_db[str_detect(string = merged_db$taxon, pattern = fixed("add_group:")),]

colnames(guild_order_df) <- c("daughter","parent","reference")
guild_order_df <- guild_order_df[,c("daughter","parent")]
guild_order_df$daughter <- str_replace_all(string = guild_order_df$daughter, pattern = fixed("add_group:"), replacement = "")

### Use igraph and dplyr to do a topographic sort (i.e. leafs always before parents) of the resulting network
g <- graph_from_data_frame(guild_order_df, directed = TRUE)
ord <- names(topo_sort(g, mode = "out"))

guild_order_df_ordered <- guild_order_df |> 
  mutate(order = match(daughter, ord)) |> 
  arrange(order) |> 
  select(-order)

### These are all the guilds that will need to be sorted
all_new_funcs <- unique(merged_db$guild)

### These are all the daughters (nested categories)
order_daughters <- unique(guild_order_df_ordered$daughter)

### These are all the umbrella categories
order_parents <- unique(guild_order_df_ordered$parent)
order_parents <- order_parents[!(order_parents %in% order_daughters)]

### We will put daughters before parents
order_all_nested <- c(order_daughters,
                      order_parents)

### ... and non-nested categories before nested ones
guild_order <- c(all_new_funcs[!(all_new_funcs %in% order_all_nested )],
                 order_all_nested)

# Write the merged database out in v1 format
output_file <- "FAPROTAX2_plus.tmp"

longest_name = 55

my_connection <- file(output_file, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines("##############################################################################################", con = my_connection)
writeLines("# Combined FAPROTAX1 and FAPROTAX2 databases plus custom functions", con = my_connection)
writeLines("##############################################################################################", con = my_connection)
writeLines("", con = my_connection)
writeLines("", con = my_connection)



## Create FAPROTAX1 type of records in temporary files for each of the function
for (func in seq_along(guild_order)){
  #func = 107
 
  cat("Processing guild:", guild_order[func], "\n")
  # Subset and filter the dataframe accordingly
  merged_db_sub <- merged_db[merged_db$guild == guild_order[func],]
  merged_db_sub <- merged_db_sub[!is.na(merged_db_sub$guild),]
  
  # Remove all entries without a reference but only for entries that are not "add_group" entries
  #merged_db_sub <- merged_db_sub[!is.na(merged_db_sub$source) &
  #                                 str_detect(merged_db_sub$taxon, pattern = fixed("add_group:")),]
  merged_db_sub$source[is.na(merged_db_sub$source)] <- ""
  
  # Sort by species name
  merged_db_sub <- merged_db_sub[order(merged_db_sub$taxon),]
  
  # Write function header to file
  writeLines(guild_order[func], con = my_connection)
  writeLines("# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -", con = my_connection)
  # Loop through the species for putting them into the file
  for (species in seq_along(merged_db_sub$taxon)){
    #species = 1
    # Pad species name with the right number of tabs
    current_species <- merged_db_sub$taxon[species]
    current_ref <- merged_db_sub$source[species]
    # Convert reference to plain ASCII
    current_ref <- iconv(current_ref,
                         from = "",
                         to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT",
                         sub = "")
    
    output_line <- sprintf("%-*s # %s",
                           longest_name,
                           current_species,
                           current_ref)
    # Write output line
    writeLines(output_line, con = my_connection)
  }
  writeLines("", con = my_connection)
  writeLines("", con = my_connection)
}
close(my_connection)

# Append copyright statement to file
system2(
  command = "cat", 
  args = c("faprotax_copyright_statement.txt", "FAPROTAX2_plus.tmp"), 
  stdout = "FAPROTAX2_BT.txt"
)
```
